institutional_scope: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, Southern District of Texas

remedy.notes: Memorandum Opinion (ECF 312) by Chief Judge Eduardo V. Rodriguez; a conforming separate order was entered simultaneously and is a second primary document. The court did not find that Westlaw Precision produced the fabrications and expressly held causation immaterial, so the AI-establishment basis is counsel’s admission of use, not a judicial finding of tool output. The fee award is compensatory and joint and several with the Petitioning Creditors, not a penalty against counsel alone; the Fifth Circuit bars fee awards for court-initiated Rule 11(c)(1)(B) sanctions, which is why it rests on inherent power and § 105(a). Fee total verified by itemized arithmetic.
